info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Plans-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables users to access and retrieve detailed information about the various streaming subscription plans available. The endpoint provides insights into the features, pricing, and tiers of each plan, facilitating informed decision-making for consumers interested in streaming services. Typical users include developers looking to integrate subscription options into their applications or businesses seeking to understand potential offerings. With this API, organizations can effectively manage their subscription strategies and optimize user engagement.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the complete list of available subscription plans, providing details such as pricing, features, and availability. Use this to inform users about their options when subscribing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve available subscription plans. It should specify the criteria for fetching the plans, providing necessary parameters in the JSON format to guide the request.
